title: Fabric-CICD tool v1.2.0 – new bulk publish mode (Preview)

content.text: fabric-cicd bulk publish mode lets fabric-cicd publish multiple items in one Fabric bulk import API call and fall back to standard publishing for unsupported scenarios.
